worldEncounter.evidence: Fixed-C call site invokes BATTLE_CreateVsEnemy with mode 0 and npcindex -1; no WinFunc assignment is performed at that call site.

npcEnemy.evidence: npc_npcenemy.c assigns BattleArray[...].WinFunc = NPC_NPCEnemy_Dying after successful creation.

pvp.evidence: Fixed-C sets PkFunc during BATTLE_CreateVsPlayer under _DEATH_CONTEND.

dantai.evidence: BATTLE_Finish calls BATTLE_DpCalc only for P_vs_P when DANTAI is enabled.

linkedBattle.finishBehavior: BATTLE_Finish exits linked pNext side-0 entries, marks battle mode FINAL, then deletes linked Battle containers.
linkedBattle.browserStatus: not represented in first-idle Browser Battle Context; do not synthesize linked battles.
linkedBattle.evidence: Fixed-C BATTLE_Finish iterates pNext for BATTLE_Exit, then repeats pNext for BATTLE_DeleteBattle.

browserPolicy.firstIdleWorldEncounter: winFunc=false, pvp=false, linkedBattleCount=0; ordinary reward/exit pipeline is source-applicable.
browserPolicy.npcEnemyHook: deferred unless NPC battle source injects an explicit WinFunc identity.
